response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), units AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, f.articount::numeric / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM units) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share, u.share - a.mean_share AS share_difference FROM units AS u CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.mean_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
